finding: Ordinary links do not stop owned tasks on guardian normal exit. Discarding public quic_closed hints plus an idle caller receive loop could orphan the caller.
resolution: Every owned task explicitly monitors guardian from entry; matching ref/PID DOWN including normal stops command acceptance. Caller processes DOWN around public operations and between bounded hint batches, then exits without next command/result/completion. Bootstrap stops retained descriptor and never waits for lost guardian adoption; stop task completes its sole bounded stop and exits without ACK. Endpoint acceptor monitor acts independently during synchronous calls. Finite transport/query/stop bounds and resolver timeout ownership are distinguished from request deadline; no immediate task death claimed.
